subject: Amendment Required for Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

Please review the draft Bill of Lading against the authoritative Shipping Instruction.
We have found discrepancies that require your immediate attention and amendment.
Specifically, the Consignee is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA in the draft Bill of Lading, whereas the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.
Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA in the draft, but the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.
Kindly update the draft Bill of Lading so that it matches the Shipping Instruction exactly.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
